builder_rule: HISTORICAL_SHORTEN when chain_length>1 and the path string contains ASOF, RELEASE, or PIT_. This review does not treat that substring as proof the directory never participates in a live publish.
review_rule: A record meets a concrete historical release placement only when an ancestor directory, or the link directory itself, contains ASOF/PIT_/RELEASE together with a 20xxxxxx date. A version token such as _R<digits> or v<digits>.<digits> without a date is listed separately and is not called a timestamped release. Keyword-only and unmarked records are the ones that do not meet the historical limit.
class_name_note: DATED_RELEASE_ANCESTOR means the strongest ancestor contains ASOF or PIT_ plus a 20xxxxxx date. It does not mean every row has a parent directory named releases.
